title.narrative: 6 month extension and minor adaptation of targets/activities. Extension of FDI to 28/02/28

description.narrative:
The objective of the programme is to contribute to improve the protection and promotion of human rights, particularly for those communities affected by conflict and displacement, through strengthening the capacity of the National Human Rights Commission and hence contributing to bolster the social contract and to sustain peace and development.

Outcome 1 - the NHRC has improved institutional tools, frameworks and procedures to better deliver on its mandate.

Outcome 2 - NHRC has adequate operational capacity to more consistently advocate, investigate, monitor, and report on the situation of human rights outside of Maputo capital city, particularly in communities and areas affected by conflict and displacement.
